title: Product overrides
description: A list of product-level records, keyed by barcode. An entry either corrects a product a public database already carries, or is the sole record of a product no public database has. Market-variant facts live inside the per-market records, never at the top level.

barcode.description: EAN-8, UPC-12, EAN-13 or GTIN-14, as a string, leading zeros kept.

name.description: Human-readable product name. Market-invariant. Optional when correcting a product a public database already carries, because the name comes from there. Required in practice when this override is the only record of the product anywhere: without a name there is nothing for a consumer to display.

brand.description: id of the brand. Market-invariant: the same barcode carries the same brand everywhere.

markets.description: Per-market records. One barcode can be filled by different companies in different countries, so every market-variant fact must sit under the market it was observed in.

example.description: true if this entry is a seeded template rather than curated data.

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the product was bought in.

made_in.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country of manufacture, as stated on the label. Never inferred from the barcode prefix.

operator.description: id of the entity running the plant that made this product for this market.

sources.description: Must cite a label photo or an official company statement. Transcribed label text is acceptable and is the cheapest form; prefix it with 'label text:'.

verified_on.description: ISO 8601 date on which a human last checked this record against its sources.
